title: Skip Wuzhen's ¥190 Ticket — This Water Town Is Free | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone pays to get into Wuzhen. One hour from Shanghai, Zhujiajiao gives you the same Ming-and-Qing canals, stone bridges and wooden boats — free to walk in.

Wuzhen gates its scenic old town at roughly ¥150 for the Xizha (West) section and up to ¥190 for a combined through-ticket. Zhujiajiao, about 47 km west of Shanghai and reachable on Metro Line 17, charges nothing just to enter the ancient town; you only pay if you add a boat ride or step inside a specific garden, temple or museum. Wuzhen's manicured night lighting is lovely — but that polish is exactly what the ticket pays for.

🧭 Expert Tip: take Metro Line 17 to Zhujiajiao and arrive before 9am — the canal alleys are almost empty, and the morning light on the Fangsheng Bridge is the shot everyone else queues for later.
